# `harness.lock`

The lockfile records the stack that won, pinned and hashed, along with the evidence for
choosing it. `hlock resolve` writes it. Don't edit it by hand, and do commit it.

## Example

This is the lock from the [Quickstart](../getting-started/quickstart.md):

```toml title="harness.lock"
# This file is generated by harness-lock. Do not edit by hand.
lock-version = 1
generated-by = "harness-lock 0.1.2"
manifest-hash = "sha256:e6471474cb158117c727fbf3371e2287935d191f16c71c24c14ea80ca54693e2"

[stack]
name = "demo"
selection = "min-cost"

[[llm]]
role = "planner"
provider = "reference"
model = "qwen-7b"
resolved-from = "reference:qwen-7b"
fingerprint = "sha256:5aa2f4197dd24bf9889327f484ae9e7edbc8da533621923fbcae65e99f01bb86"

[decision]
kind = "none"

[harness]
name = "reference"
pattern = "single-agent"

[policy]
retries = 1
max-steps = 40
human-approval = "never"

[context]
isolation = "locked-only"

[evidence]
task-pack = "./tasks"
split = "search"
trials = 2

[evidence.success-rate]
mean = 1.0

[evidence.cost-usd-per-task]
mean = 0.0001

[evidence.latency-s-per-task]
p50 = 0.259
p95 = 0.395

[provenance]
backend = "local"
```

Empty tables and lists are omitted above for brevity. `hlock show --json` prints
the complete file.

## Top-level keys

| Key | Description |
|---|---|
| `lock-version` | Schema version. This release reads and writes `1`. |
| `generated-by` | The `harness-lock` version that wrote the lock |
| `manifest-hash` | Hash of the `harness.toml` the lock was resolved from. Used by `hlock check`. |

## Sections

| Section | Contents |
|---|---|
| `[stack]` | Stack name, and the `select` rule that chose it |
| `[[llm]]` | One entry per role: `provider`, `model`, the candidate string it came from, a `fingerprint`, and `params` |
| `[decision]` | Decision model `kind`, its `decisions`, and `thresholds` |
| `[harness]` | Harness `name` and `pattern` |
| `[policy]` | `retries`, `max-steps`, `human-approval`, `risky-actions`, `tool-allowlist`, `sandbox` |
| `[context]` | Context `isolation` and `compaction` settings |
| `tool`, `skill`, `instructions` | Locked peripherals (reserved in v0.1) |
| `[evidence]` | The task pack and split measured, the trial count, and success-rate, cost, and latency statistics |
| `[verify]` | Runtime verification thresholds: `canary-tasks`, `min-success-rate`, `fingerprint-tolerance` |
| `[provenance]` | The backend that produced the lock, and the search settings |

## `harness.opt.lock`

[`hlock optimize`](../guides/optimize.md) writes a separate opt-lock with the same shape,
plus what the optimizer produced: the chosen hyperparameters, applied prompts, fine-tune
adapters, the data split, and the budget, all content-addressed. Adopt it into
`harness.lock` with `hlock optimize --apply`.

## `harness.lock.prev`

[`hlock upgrade --apply`](../guides/upgrade.md) saves the previous lock here so
`hlock upgrade --rollback` can restore it. You can commit it or ignore it.
